job: Choose a start and an end date, with presets for the usual ranges.
purpose: A date range panel: presets (24h, 7d, 30d, month, custom) beside a Monday-first month grid. Click a start and an end; the range previews as you hover, then Apply writes the label into the trigger and fires fd:change with ISO dates. Cancel restores the last applied range. Future days can be disabled for logs. With a compare band it becomes a period (see period).
useWhen: A log, a chart or a report is filtered by a time range.
People mostly want the same few ranges but sometimes a custom one.
